findings.title: Phone number isn't tappable
findings.detail: On a phone, customers have to copy your number by hand, so some of them give up instead of calling.

findings.title: Opening hours are hard to find
findings.detail: They sit at the bottom of the page in small grey text, so people can't tell if you're open.

findings.title: Menu is a PDF
findings.detail: PDFs are slow and awkward on phones, which means fewer people see what you sell.

fixes: Opening hours right at the top
A menu that reads well on phones
